plugin.name: Music_Mods_Combined.esp
plugin.description:
Merges every music mod's track lists into one patch, so no mod's music is silenced by another and the vanilla tracks stay in the rotation. Then weights them: Melodies of Civilization leads in towns and palaces, Around the Fire in taverns, Dawnguard Music Overhaul in Dawnguard areas, Nyghtfall in combat and at night (20:00-06:00), Chapter II / Celtic / Still share the wilderness by day, and Chapter II / Celtic / Still / LORKHAN share the wilderness and dungeons equally by day. Pauses between songs are short: a 10-second silence on about 5% of picks.
Works with LORKHAN - Soundtrack Replacer (optional, no plugin needed): it replaces the vanilla music files, so the vanilla tracks it covers play LORKHAN's music as an equal partner. Each mod's own rules about when its tracks play (time of day, Dawnguard eclipse, location, combat against dragons) are untouched.
Needs ALL of these enabled, with this patch loading after them: Melodies of Civilization.esp Dawnguard Music Overhaul.esp Dawnguard Music Overhaul - Combat.esp Still.esp Celtic_Music_In_Skyrim_SE.esp Celtic_Music_In_Skyrim_SE_Dungeon.esp Around the Fire.esp NyghtfallMM_NonReplacer.esp Chapter II - Soundtrack mod by Dreyma Music.esp
Does not need "MelOfCiv - Chapter II Patch.esp" or "Still - Chapter II Patch.esp" (made for Chapter II v3.5).
ESL-flagged, so it uses no plugin slot.
